Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

The third-party integration required for the project has taken longer to certify than expected, and as a result the delivery timeline has shifted by two weeks. We now expect to deliver the completed project on 14 April.

The certification process is outside our direct control, but our team has continued building and testing the surrounding components in parallel so that once certification clears, integration and final delivery can proceed without further delay. We are treating this timeline as firm and will keep you updated if anything changes before then.

Does 14 April still work well with your internal planning, or is there a specific milestone on your end we should factor into the remaining schedule?
